test_is_monotonic_with_nat: test the is_monotonic_increasing property on DatetimeIndex, PeriodIndex, and TimedeltaIndex with NaT values
test_monotonic_increasing_clean_index: test that a clean DatetimeIndex, PeriodIndex, and TimedeltaIndex are monotonic_increasing and not monotonic_decreasing
test_monotonic_with_nat_at_start: test that inserting NaT at the beginning of a DatetimeIndex makes is_monotonic_increasing return false
test_monotonic_with_nat_at_end: test that inserting NaT at the end of a DatetimeIndex makes is_monotonic_increasing return false
test_is_unique_with_nat: test that Index objects with NaT values still report is_unique as true
